run_adsorb_atoms: run adsorb_atoms to relax an adslab system and compute adsorption energy with a given calculator
compute_adsorption_energy_hybrid: compute hybrid adsorption energy by combining ML-relaxed adslab energies with DFT slab reference energies
compute_adsorption_energy_full: compute full adsorption energy by relaxing both the adslab and bare surface with the ML calculator
relax_adslab_with_optimizer: relax an adsorbate-slab atoms object using an ASE optimizer and return the relaxed structure and energy
save_relaxed_adslab_atoms: save relaxed adslab and optionally relaxed slab atoms as encoded JSON in the adsorption results dictionary
